experiment: Local audio-LLM direct note transcription; no Basic Pitch or other transcription tools supplied to the model. Not a tool-using arranging-agent evaluation.

protocol.primary: Fresh single-turn audio-first requests; original WAV bytes, fixed prompt, temperature zero, reasoning none, JSON object, 8192 output tokens. Audio-only inference does not read annotations.
protocol.references: Same 12 composer held-out files as Basic Pitch; three presets, two seeds, piano and mixture; 924 unioned reference events.
protocol.matching: Maximum one-to-one exact MIDI pitch, 50 ms onset; see piano_transcription.py. Raw metrics retain complete parseable out-of-bounds candidates; accepted-draft metrics reject the whole invalid draft. Invalid/truncated prose is a failure, never silently repaired.
protocol.scope: Only these local Gemma 4/Ollama configurations. E4B did not pass spoken positive controls. No claim about every audio LLM, cloud models, multi-step tool use or piano-arranging quality.
protocol.timing: Primary elapsed times include HTTP/preprocessing/generation. Basic Pitch times are historical same-file Rust measurements, not interleaved speed benchmarks. Diagnostic probes overlapped cargo compilation. No external audio uploads, model downloads or paid inference calls.
protocol.probe_exclusion: Initial A4 transport probe contained an example note matching the stimulus and is excluded from all musical accuracy metrics.

run.prompt:
Transcribe the attached instrumental audio into all audible pitched notes.
Return only a JSON object with keys "notes" and "limitations".
"notes" is a list of objects with "pitch" (integer MIDI key), "start" and "end"
(seconds from the beginning of the attached audio). Include simultaneous notes
separately and repeated attacks as separate events. Do not replace transcription
with a newly composed melody. For silence return an empty notes list. If you
cannot determine any notes, return an empty list and explain in "limitations".
Do not invent a score. No reference score or transcription tool is available.
